## Authentication

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /` — Retrieve the homepage content.
- `GET /nac/2` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Retrieve conversion data.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /b` — Submit batch data.
- `POST /data/1.11.2/tosspos` — Submit tossplace data.
- `POST /event-log/api/v1/web/egapemoh-tneve` — Log a specific event.
- `POST /p/c` — Submit product catalog data.

### Search (1)
- `GET /front/v8/elastic/plugins/{pluginId}` — Search for a plugin by ID.

### Media (1)
- `GET /lotties/interaction-scroll-light.json` — Download a Lottie animation file.

### Realtime (2)
- `POST /api/v3.1/apps/tosspos/events/web/{webId}` — Send a real-time web event.
- `POST /front/v8/channels/{channelId}/events` — Send a real-time event to a channel.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /front/v8/elastic/plugins/{pluginId}/boot` — Boot a plugin.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Tossplace's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Tossplace data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.tossplace.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Tossplace frontend uses
